== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34718) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Aasen DS ROTS Dooku.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 28 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>22efa03f6ebfff88ebb4ce678576086ce20bb053f78c7ec348e4addfe6d87e86</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>207_30</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Grand Admiral Thrawn (AI) (V)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
